correctness.rationale: Cubic sign/permutation symmetries reduce quartic isotropy to J400=3J220. Rebuilt the even-monomial exact simplex inclusion–exclusion integral across c in (0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,∞), and independently recovered the stated degree-seven defect polynomial and the negative/positive endpoint values. Möbius transforms c=(1+2z)/(1+z) yield the sign sequence ++++++-- (one positive zero by Descartes); c=(2+3z)/(1+z) yields eight strictly negative coefficients, excluding another root; outer octahedron/cube regimes fixed signs. Independent exact symbolic integration recovered sixth defect polynomial and evaluated negative about −0.030309048901344227 at c*=1.6990676583226154; interval-sign certificate supplies proof beyond floating point. Octahedral symmetry implies second-order isotropy for every c, and 24 coordinate signed-permutations of (1,c−1,0) support 6 quadrangular/8 hexagonal facets.
